framing.lineOfInquiry: Varun Bansal (P00261) may have been involved in the incident recorded in CASE003
framing.alternate: Varun Bansal (P00261) was not involved — the evidence has an innocent explanation
framing.note: KRONOS starts from the presumption of innocence. The line of inquiry and the alternates are tested against the same records; neither is a finding, and the strengths are not probabilities.

alternateHypotheses.title: Named or given a role in error

alternateHypotheses.label: Moderate

alternateHypotheses.statement: Varun Bansal's calls and messages reflect a long-standing relationship (family, work, business), not planning of the incident.
